title: Jinrui Kyuusai Game
description:
One day, Doppo, the high school protagonist, suddenly heard a voice from his phone saying “The game has begun.” and that the “chosen challengers” have been taken to another world. If they complete their mission, they can return to their original world. However, this new world is filled with terrifying monsters… Can they survive and return to their original world?!

تابع أحداث وتطورات Jinrui Kyuusai Game مع تحديثات يومية وتجربة قراءة فائقة السلاسة وبدقة عالية حصرياً على موقع مانجا تايم (MangaTime).
